decisions.reason: The enclosed manual laser workstation draws on the firm's in-house laser know-how and complements the new laser line, so management can read the market feedback and refine the models rather than withdraw them.
The thermal inkjet printer sits at the core of the firm's coding competence in inks, printheads and line integration, which lets it absorb customer feedback and keep improving the product.
The piezo inkjet printer extends the firm's established inkjet and Industry 4.0 traceability know-how, and its own R&D gives it the capacity to develop the product further.
The industrial laser marking line is the firm's showcased flagship and builds directly on its in-house laser development, making withdrawal very unlikely.
The compact laser cabin fits within the firm's established laser workstation family, so it can be interpreted and refined with existing knowledge alongside the flagship laser systems.
The award-winning lubricant printing system applies the firm's high-resolution inkjet expertise to a new sheet-metal niche, and its own R&D lets it learn from early industrial use.
